svg.aria-label: A crayon cartoon of the BHASHINI VYOMA grand finale: finalists and organisers stand in two rows in front of the VYOMA screen, with confetti and gold stars. Team Sangrah is marked with a red bracket, and their official BHASHINI certificate of achievement is taped beside the story. Winner of the BHASHINI VYOMA Innovation Challenge 2026: one of 4 national winning teams out of 10 finalists; grand finale at IIIT-Delhi; 10 lakh rupees prize money and a 2 lakh grant; featured in a Government of India PIB release. Akansha conceived Apna Saathi and led a team of four: offline voice AI in 9 languages on a Jetson, replying in 2.70 seconds median inside a 5 to 8 second budget, passing 8 of 8 safety checks with zero unsafe answers.
